## RF - AI Stage
Called by the main workflow once per stage (idea, song, storyboard, metadata, qc).
Gemini (free tier) first; if it errors after 3 tries -> local Ollama.
Invalid JSON -> up to 3 attempts with the validator's error fed back. Prompts + JSON schemas live in **Prepare**.

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ ($json.ctx.pkg.video_id || 'no-id') + ' | ' + $json.ctx.stage + ' stage: AI output invalid after ' + ($json.attempt + 1) + ' attempts: ' + $json.error }}
